```{r}
library(pollinatorSDM)
library(terra)

n <- 50 * 50
ext <- c(-10, 10, 30, 50)

r1 <- rast(nrows = 50, ncols = 50, crs = "EPSG:4326", extent = ext, vals = rnorm(n, 15, 10))
r2 <- rast(nrows = 50, ncols = 50, crs = "EPSG:4326", extent = ext, vals = rgamma(n, 2, 0.01))
r3 <- rast(nrows = 50, ncols = 50, crs = "EPSG:4326", extent = ext, vals = sample(1:5, n, replace = TRUE))
r4 <- rast(nrows = 50, ncols = 50, crs = "EPSG:4326", extent = ext, vals = runif(n, 0, 3000))

env_rasters <- c(r1, r2, r3, r4)
names(env_rasters) <- c("temperature", "precipitation", "landcover", "elevation")

occ <- download_pollinator_data(limit = 20)
occ_clean <- clean_occurrences(occ)
preds <- prepare_predictors(occ_clean, env_rasters)
preds$presence <- 1

bg <- generate_background_points(env_rasters, n = 500)
bg$presence <- 0

model <- train_sdm_model(preds, bg)
pred <- predict_pollinator_distribution(model, env_rasters)
plot_pollinator_map(pred)
```
